description: The accuracy corpus manifest: labeled positives live in fixtures/bench manifests; the clean_* directories are negative controls judged by scripts/accuracy_benchmark.py. known_fps records the false positives the controls deliberately carry - each with its reason, each visible in every report.

known_fps.reason: fmt.Println is a CLI's legitimate stdout report; the textual check cannot model output intent, so the rule stays advisory and is not promotion-ready until intent-aware evidence exists
